title: James More

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. Q. D. 260....
Date....5....6....29....

June 4, 9

Sir,

James More.

With reference to your letter No. 753 dated
May 30 no trace can be found of James More. Enquiries
at No. 84 Bubbling Well Road show that no person
bearing this name has lived there since December 1,
1928, approximately, when the house came into
possession of the present proprietress.

Enquiries are being continued and any information
obtained regarding More's whereabouts will be
immediately communicated to you.

Yours faithfully,

A.
A/ B. C. L.
for Commissioner of Police.

Consul General for Italy,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. Q. D. 260....
日期....5....6....29....

六月四日，九时

先生：

詹姆斯·莫尔（James More）。

关于您五月三十日第753号来函，经查无詹姆斯·莫尔之踪迹。经向静安寺路84号查询，自1928年12月1日左右该房屋由现任女业主接管以来，并无以此姓名居住之人。

查询工作仍在继续，凡获得有关莫尔下落之任何信息，将立即通知阁下。

此致
敬礼

A.
代理警务总监 B. C. L.
代警务总监

意大利驻上海总领事

Date... 3... 6... 29）

3-6-29

CONTINUATION
SHEET

Sir;

With reference to the attached letter from
the Consul General for Italy, enquiries have been made
at 84 Bubbling Well Road but no one of the name mentioned
has lived at this address, since the boarding house was
taken over by the present occupier which is some 6
months ago.

C B Henry
D.S.I.

Supt. B. Division.

WWK.

O'Dunne.
myli.

A.C. (Crime). Req.
Reply as above
E. K.
6/6

续页

关于附呈的意大利总领事来函，已向静安寺路84号进行查询，但自该寄宿舍由现住客接管（约六个月前）以来，并无上述姓名之人居住于此。

page_data.en:
CONSOLATO GENERALE D'ITALIA
SHANGHAI

（印：SHANGHAI Municipal Police C. I. D. No. I. Q. D. 260 Date 5. 6. 29）

No. 753.
Pos. C. 13. c.
Shanghai, May 30th. 1929.

Sir,

It came to my notice that a certain James More -84 Bubbling Well Road -is pretending to be an Italian subject. As the same is quite unknown to this Consulate General, I would ask that he be requested by the Police to show his papers and, in case of
（批：Rush //）his appearing to be Italian and the Police having any suspect upon his identity, that he be accompanied to this Consular Office for further investigations.

I remain,
Sir,

Yours faithfully
（签名）
Consul General for Italy

Acting Commissioner of Police.
SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
意大利驻上海总领事馆
上海

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 编号 I. Q. D. 260 日期 29. 6. 5）

第753号。
Pos. C. 13. c.
上海，1929年5月30日。

先生：

本人获悉，一名叫詹姆斯·莫尔（James More）的人——住址静安寺路84号——自称是意大利臣民。鉴于本总领事馆对此人完全不知情，故请警方要求其出示证件，若其
（批注：加急 //）看似为意大利人且警方对其身份有任何怀疑，则将其带至本领事馆作进一步调查。

此致
敬礼

（签名）
意大利总领事

代理警务总监
上海
